title: prunus × lannesiana f. appendiculata
intro: Prunus × lannesiana f. appendiculata, commonly known as the Japanese cherry or yamadori, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. The health benefits of Prunus × lannesiana f. appendiculata include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its high content of flavonoids and phenolic acids. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Prunus × lannesiana f. appendiculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds such as quercetin, kaempferol, and isorhapontigenin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
